programs.title: Here and Now
programs.desc: Features stories that impact the black community; leaders and experts voice their opinions on a variety of topics including politics, the economy, education and health issues.

programs.title: Home for Good
programs.desc: Art and the team extend their hand to help firefighter and paramedic, Ronnie Estep, a 27-year-old father whose old home burned to the ground; in just seven days, the team tackles a complete makeover of the kitchen but goes above and beyond by renovating the living room, office space, dining room, plus a special surprise in store for this deserving family.

programs.title: National Cherry Blossom Festival
programs.desc: The annual celebration and parade in Washington, D.C. features dazzling floats with prominent celebrities and cherished animated characters, vibrant firework displays, and live concerts by renowned musicians.

programs.title: Live: NBA Tip-Off
programs.desc: Host Ernie Johnson and analysts Shaquille O'Neal, Charles Barkley and Kenny Smith ready viewers for NBA action before ESPN's Wednesday night doubleheaders (and other select telecasts). Guest analysts also are featured from time to time.

programs.title: Live: 2026 NBA Draft Lottery
programs.desc: The 14 NBA teams that didn't qualify for this year's playoffs are eligible for the NBA Draft Lottery. The lottery determines which teams will have the top four picks and the selection order of the remaining 10 teams.
